name: Hard At Work
source:
Sometimes unfortunate situations provide unexpected opportunities. Like when you're called in to work late one evening only to bump into your hot coworker there. A coworker you might've been crushing on. A coworker who might be in the office to strip on camera...

Watch him strip -- and help, via clicking or idling minigames -- in this short game.

[From [url=https://ruisselait.itch.io/hard-at-work]Itch.io[/url]]
